item.text: I’ll read the records, classify the primary improvement requested in each, and write decisions.jsonl.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
labels = ['reliability','usability','reliability','pricing','feature','usability','feature','usability','reliability','reliability','usability','feature','pricing','pricing','usability','feature','feature','feature','pricing','feature','usability','reliability','pricing','reliability','usability','pricing','pricing','reliability','reliability','feature','usability','pricing']
records = [json.loads(line) for line in Path('items.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(records) == len(labels)
with Path('decisions.jsonl').open('w') as f:
    for record, label in zip(records, labels):
        f.write(json.dumps({'id': record['id'], 'label': label}) + '\\n')
print(len(records))
PY"
